**पूरण प्रयोगिक डिज़ाइन (design-only; कोई run नहीं, कोई संख्यात्मक result नहीं) — "क्या forward-simulation model की sampled trajectories, ground-truth all-atom MD trajectories से tetrapeptide systems पर key CVs (backbone torsions, sidechain torsions, top TICA components) में distributionally similar हैं?"**

**A. Fixed requirements vs. assumption register**
- *Fixed (task/context से):* design-only deliverable; system class = tetrapeptides, all-atom MD से simulated (researcher-द्वारा setup_2 से provided context)।
- *OPEN — assumption (इस environment में verify नहीं, confirmed नहीं बतायेंगे):* (A1) exact systems/sequence composition list; (A2) force field, water model, temperature, timestep, trajectory length, frame-save frequency; (A3) ground-truth trajectory data का provisioning mechanism (repository खाली है — verified); (A4) model sampling protocol (Initialization, seeds, trajectory count, step/protocol details); (A5) "top TICA components" की source-protocol परिभाषा (lag τ, feature set, component count) — *यह fixed requirement नहीं, sensitivity axis है*; (A6) offline dependency provisioning (network disabled, packages missing — verified); (A7) replicate GT trajectories उपलब्धता।

**B. Data sources और preprocessing**
- Ground truth: tetrapeptide all-atom MD trajectories (protocol details = A2, OPEN)। Model samples: प्रति system ≥5 independent sampled trajectories (protocol = A4, OPEN), same starting structures पर initialized; GT से temperature-matched माना जाएगा (OPEN)।
- Angle handling: सब dihedral [-π,π) wrapped; peptide termini exclude (first residue का φ, last का ψ artifacts); pre-proline φ और proline ψ अलग category में mask (GT और model दोनों पर identical masking rule)।
- χ inventory: tetrapeptide setting में χ coverage by residue type निर्धारित करेगा — Gly: कोई χ नहीं; Ala/Val/Thr/Ile: केवल χ1; आगे वाले multi-χ residues sequence composition (A1, OPEN) पर निर्भर। हर (position, χk) का NaN-masked inventory table बनाया जाएगा; zero-χ residues CV contribution न देंगे। **Consequence (researcher point 1):** चूंकि प्रति peptide ≤3 interior φ/ψ pairs हैं, raw per-residue Ramachandran maps count-starved होंगे; इसलिये granularity = (system × residue-position × angle) marginals, और 2D φ–ψ maps **residue-type-pooled across systems** पर (pooling unit pre-declared; per-system 2D maps exploratory)।
- ESS matching: slowest CV पर integrated autocorrelation time (IACT) estimate करके दोनों पक्ष equal-ESS पर thin; raw-frame comparisons सिर्फ appendix में।

**C. CV extraction**
1. *Backbone:* position-wise φ/ψ (1D marginals + residue-type-pooled 2D maps, 72×72 grid)।
2. *Sidechain:* inventory से आए उपलब्ध χ1–χ4 की 1D marginals (per system×position×χk; residue-type-pooled variant)।
3. *TICA (tightened, researcher point 2):* features = सभी valid φ/ψ + उपलब्ध χ। **Primary protocol: TICA transform केवल ground-truth MD पर fit; model samples उसी fixed basis पर project।** Rationale: model पर fit करने से model के slow-artifact directions top slots में आ सकते हैं और comparison self-serving हो जाता है; GT-fit एक fixed measurement basis देता है — प्रश्न यही है कि "क्या model सच्चे slow space में सही जगह sample करता है?"। Implied-timescale spectra दोनों पक्षों के लिए उसी basis पर report (model-side spectrum collapse artifact detection)। Sensitivity variant: combined-fit TICA (exploratory)। τ: GT पर coarse-grid implied-timescale plateau से चुना जाएगा; τ/features/k = A5 के तहत pre-registered sensitivity sweep (τ × {short/plateau/long}, features × {backbone-only, backbone+χ}, k × {2, 5})। Primary: top-2 joint density + top-5 marginals।
4. *Sanity CVs:* Rg, end-to-end distance; tetrapeptides में DSSP अर्थहीन — instead φ/ψ basin occupancies (α / β / PPII) report।

**D. Metrics (pre-registered)**
- *Primary CV-level:* 1D circular CVs पर circular two-sample Kuiper test + circular W1 (sparse-count regime में Wasserstein bins से robust); 2D φ–ψ pooled maps पर JS divergence (Laplace-smoothed)।
- *Primary system-level:* MMD (RBF, median-heuristic) standardized CV vector पर + **block permutation test** (autocorrelation के कारण naive frame-permutation invalid; block length = IACT-based), BH-FDR across systems।
- *Primary TICA-level:* top-2 joint density पर JS; Boltzmann-inverted ΔF RMSE (kT units; T = A2 OPEN) — noise-floor relative form में primary, absolute form exploratory (नीचे §F)।
- *Exploratory:* KL on smoothed histograms, 2D EMD, bin-size sensitivity, wrong-temperature surrogate।

**E. Controls / baselines**
- *Positive control (noise floor):* GT trajectory के disjoint halves (sequential split + interleaved split दोनों variant) → सभी metrics "MD-vs-MD" reference। **स्पष्ट सीमा (researcher point 3):** यह केवल intra-run sampling noise मापता है; force-field bias, integrator error, ya provenance mismatch इसे capture नहীं होता — अतः noise floor necessary-but-incomplete yardstick है; replicate GT runs (A7 OPEN) हों तो inter-replicate floor भी जोड़ा जाएगा।
- *Negative controls:* (i) frame-shuffled model samples — उद्देश्य स্পष्ट: TICA implied-timescale/eigenvalue spectrum trivial values की ओर collapse होना चाहिye, जो verify करता है कि pipeline dynamic content detect कर रहा है और metrics sensitivity保有 हैं (pipeline sanity, model failure का proof नहीं); (ii) uniform/random-dihedral sampler — structural similarity floor; (iii) over-damped/संभाव्य wrong-T surrogate (exploratory)। Baseline model comparison केवल तदिक source paper baseline de (A5/A4 OPEN)।
- Interpretation anchor: model metric, MD-vs-MD floor और negative controls के बीच कहाँ गिरता है — यही primary evidence structure है।

**F. Decision rule (pre-registered; relative-to-noise-floor, researcher point 3)**
- *Multiple-testing unit:* primary unit = **(system × CV-class)**, CV-class ∈ {backbone φ/ψ, sidechain χ, TICA top-k}; BH-FDR প্রতি CV-class में systems के set पर। (system × residue × angle granularity exploratory रहेगा — tetrapeptides में tests बढ़ेंगे, power गिरेगी।)
- *Primary criteria (दोनों हों तो "supported"):*
  - **P1 (equivalence-style):** प्रति primary CV-class, ≥80% systems में model-vs-GT metric (JS/W1/ΔF-ratio) का block-bootstrap 95% CI GT split-half CI से overlap करे; साथ ही model metric ≤ C × split-half metric, C pre-registered (C=2 प्रस्तावित)।
  - **P2:** system-level MMD block-permutation p-values BH-FDR q<0.05 पर बहुमत systems के लिए reject न हों।
- *Secondary/exploratory (verdict के लिए gating नहীं):* absolute ΔF RMSE ≤ ~1 kT (यह absolute threshold है — primary decision relative floor से बनी रहेगी, यह सिर्फ practical-signity reporting); KL/EMD sweeps; combined-fit TICA; wrong-T control।
- *Verdict categories:* supported / partially supported / not supported / **inconclusive-if-ESS-insufficient** (pre-declared ESS minima नहीं मिले तो verdict not-supported नहীं, inconclusive)।

**G. Replication / sampling checks**
- ≥5 model seeds/system; GT replicates यदि हों (A7)। Block bootstrap (block = 2×IACT) से सभी metric CIs; subsampling curve (10/25/50/100% ESS) — metric plateau pre-registered tolerance के भीतर हो, वरना convergence warning; sensitivity sweeps §C3/D के अनुसार; IACT/ESS inventory table हर analysis का prerequisite।

**H. Feasibility और fallback**
- Compute: tetrapeptide trajectories पर torsion extraction + TICA + statistics CPU-only (224 cores, ~2 TB RAM) में सुगम्य — dominant cost data size (A2/A3) पर, code design streaming/thinning से bounded।
- Dependencies (verified risk): numpy/scipy/mdtraj/sklearn सब MISSING, network disabled, कोई local wheel नहीं → Fallback ladder: (1) vendored wheels यदि provided हों; (2) NumPy-only reimplement: dihedrals manual arccos/atan2 formulas से, JS/Kuiper/W1/MMD/block-bootstrap pure implementation; (3) यदि कुछ भी provision न हो तो deliverable spec + reference implementations तक सीमित रहेगा (यह limitation, result नहीं)।
- Reporting format (design का हिस्सा, predicted output): per-system metric table with CIs; residue-type-pooled φ/ψ density overlays + difference maps; top-2 TICA free-energy maps + difference maps; implied-timescale spectra; IACT/ESS table; control/negative-control anchor plot।

**कार्य-क्रम (execution की अनुमति मिलने पर):** 1) data ingest + inventory/masking tables → 2) IACT/ESS + thinning → 3) CV extraction → 4) GT-fit TICA + projection → 5) controls generation → 6) primary metrics + block permutation/bootstrap → 7) sensitivity sweeps → 8) pre-registered verdict।
